title: Fallout: New Vegas
synopsis: Obsidian’s Fallout: New Vegas on Steam — the Obsidian-developed chapter between Fallout 3 and the later Bethesda Game Studios releases on this shelf.

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Obsidian build published by Bethesda Softworks
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Held open for curator writing on New Vegas as the Obsidian chapter in this Fallout issue.
collectionNotes: This holding is a Steam license only. No boxed edition sits beside it. Supplementary scans and photography remain unfiled by design. Official cover artwork is recorded from Steam library art.

preservation.playableOn: Windows through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title.
preservation.concerns: As with other account-bound Steam holdings: platform dependency, policy change, and the absence of a retained offline installer.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam edition of Fallout: New Vegas. The filing documents the licensed digital copy in custody.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.
